name: skill-test-skill
description: Tests and scores any Agent Skill against the official anthropics/skills specification. Use this skill when you need to check if a skill repository or SKILL.md file is compliant with the Agent Skills standard, audit skill quality, get a compliance score, or receive specific improvement suggestions.
